fields.whyD: 14 adds 8 to 6; halving the workers doubles the time.
fields.explanationTl: Ang trabaho ay 8 × 6 = 48 worker-days, kaya 48 ÷ 4 = 12 days para sa 4 workers.
fields.stepsTl:
1. Total work: 8 × 6 = 48 worker-days.
2. Sa 4 workers: 48 ÷ 4 = 12 days.
fields.hintTl: Mas kaunting workers = mas maraming araw. Kunin muna ang total worker-days.
